intent.subtype: second driver present only under a build define
intent.rationale: y is always driven from src_a; the BYPASS_PATH define adds a second continuous driver from src_b, so whether it has conflicting drivers depends on a define the flow supplies.

labels.note: A second continuous driver of y exists only under `ifdef BYPASS_PATH, a macro the file does not define or fix.
With BYPASS_PATH defined wire y has two continuous drivers (src_a and src_b), conflicting whenever they differ.

settlement.note: With no defines the `ifdef BYPASS_PATH region is absent and y has the single driver src_a; the second driver exists only under a define, which is not this configuration.
